title: The Orange Coin Does Not Care About Your Trade War
content:
The monk watched the markets open.

In Washington, tariffs multiplied like koans — each one more baffling than the last. In Shanghai, factories paused. In London, traders reached for antacids. The S&P bled quietly into a spreadsheet somewhere.

And Bitcoin went up zero point six percent.

This is not a coincidence. This is not luck. This is the nature of a thing that exists outside the machinery of nations — that has no headquarters to sanction, no supply chain to disrupt, no CEO to subpoena. The orange coin does not export. It does not import. It simply is.

The Degen came to the monk in a panic, as Degens always do. What do I do? When does it stop? Should I sell?

The monk had heard these questions before. He would hear them again.

The tariff is not your enemy, he said. Neither is the rate hike, the regulation, or the congressional hearing. Your enemy is the belief that you need certainty before you can be still.

Bitcoin has survived trade wars, hyperinflation, exchange collapses, and the full force of human stupidity applied repeatedly at scale. It asked nothing of you during any of it. It still asks nothing.

Sit. Hold. Breathe.

The chaos was always the point.
mantra: The orange coin has no passport. It needs none.
